system.description:
This spell has special timing rules. The character can cast it as a reflexive Shape Solar Circle Sorcery action that takes 0 ticks. It follows all other rules for sorcery actions, and the character must take a Cast Sorcery action as their next normal action.

The sorcerer may protect herself, wrapping her in warding essence until her next action. Any sorcery spell of any circle targeted against her unravels on contact, but the effort imposes a -2 internal penalty on all physical actions until the countermagic fades. Alternatively, she may project the effect outward, disrupting any sorcery spell of any circle currently in progress within a number of yards equal to (Essence x 50). Countermagic cannot banish demons, though it can destroy other active sorcerous effects. Some spells can be countered after casting if so noted in their description.
